preconditions.description: Lengths of strings A and B are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in A) and all(c.islower() for c in B)
preconditions.description: Strings A and B consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: max_similarity_score == max(4 * lcs(C, D) - len(C) - len(D) for C in substrings(A) for D in substrings(B))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximal similarity score over all pairs of substrings (C, D) of A and B.
